journey.name: wear nfc hint states
journey.description:
On a ready wallet the NFC hint follows NFC live: the animated hint with NFC on, a dimmed, slashed, still icon with NFC off, whose tap opens the NFC settings. This journey is physical-only: the emulators have no NFC, so they never show either hint (the hidden, no-adapter state). There, check the `NfcHint` and `BalancePage` previews instead.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped, the watch online and NFC on. Backend: hosted regtest.

actions.action: Verify "NfcHint" is listed with the content-desc "Tap to pay"
Run `adb shell svc nfc disable` and wait 3 s
Verify "NfcHintDisabled" is listed with the content-desc "NFC off"
Verify from two screenshots 1 s apart that the icon is dimmed, slashed and still
Run `adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 topResumedActivity` and verify it names a settings activity, not `to.bitkit.dev`
Run `adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.wear.ui.MainActivity` and wait 3 s
